trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

1. **Rollback:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled all three regions back to it. After the rollback the service is healthy everywhere, with a 0.2% error rate.
2. **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the next steps. The first attempt to create it timed out. I checked the incident list, saw nothing had been created, then retried with the same idempotency key, so it couldn't create a duplicate. Only one incident exists.

v2.3.1 was also unhealthy in staging before it went to production. I noted in the incident that someone should find out how it got released anyway.
